meta.notes: TUSCANY CROSSING 103K CYCLE - strength & mobility (rev 2.0). 29 weeks, 9/28/2026 -> 4/18/2027, aligned day-for-day with run_plan rev 2.0. INPUTS: debrief v2 s5b/s10, course-demands brief v1.1 s4/s9 (eccentric -11,925 ft; Long Descent -4,574 ft gross at hours ~10-14; steep ascent >= +10% 2.4x Vermont incl. a 30%+ wall), cover note (strength copy + ask #5), athlete poles decision 9/30. || PRIORITIES: (1) POSTERIOR HEEL (FR-x) - the new weakest link and the tissue a double-distance race loads hardest; (2) DESCENT TOLERANCE at 100K dose (J-4); (3) the White River lateral-chain base (pronation, peroneals, hip/lateral stability) - unchanged, still the foundation; (4) climbing strength and pole endurance. || PERIODIZATION (Uphill Athlete model: general strength -> max strength -> muscular-endurance conversion -> specific maintenance): W1-2 re-entry (isometric, no HSR) | W3-6 GENERAL STRENGTH (10s, moderate, tempo; W6 deload + hop test) | W7-13 MAX STRENGTH (heavy 5s; moderate/light in the Gate D weeks) | W14-17 + W20 ME CONVERSION (gym ME step-ups/lunges + one heavy lift kept; eccentric step-downs; reactive layer pogo -> skip/bound) | W21-26 SPECIFIC MAINTENANCE (low volume, heavy load, decline eccentrics, pole endurance; the terrain supplies the ME) | W27-29 TAPER (maintenance -> isometrics). The run plan's on-terrain ME (steep weighted climbing) is not duplicated here. || HEEL PROTOCOL (FR-x), INSERTIONAL-SAFE: the pain sits just below the Achilles attachment, so compression at end-range dorsiflexion is the thing to avoid early. (a) Daily evening isometrics (bent-knee soleus priority) - frequency over volume; (b) HSR on the floor (seated soleus + straight-knee raises), NO DEFICIT / off-step range until 4 consecutive quiet weeks, deficit may return from W14; (c) calf stretches on flat ground; (d) progress load, not reps; (e) 24-h rule: <= 2/10 during and back to baseline next morning = right dose; worse next morning = back one step for a week and tell the coach; (f) persists > 2 weeks or returns in training = clinician look (profile). Poles from Gallina offload part of the steep-ascent calf work in the race. || DESCENT (J-4): loaded/eccentric step-downs all cycle, Nordic eccentrics from W7, decline eccentric single-leg squats W21-26; the Thursday descent ladder (run plan) is the on-terrain dose. KNEE GATE unchanged: eccentric quad work never first, bodyweight step-down check in pre_lower. || REACTIVE/SSC: SINGLE-LEG HOP TEST in Lower B Thu 11/5 (W6): 20 continuous low hops per leg, right first; PASS = pain-free + no heel/forefoot/lateral-ankle response next morning. Gates hill sprints (run W7+), pogo hops (W8+) and skips/bounds (W15+). Fail -> retest in 2 weeks. First thing pulled on any signal. || UPPER BODY (athlete standard, rev 2.1): TWO upper sessions EVERY week W1-28 (Upper A pull/pole + Upper B push/shoulder health; light versions in recovery, gate, race and taper weeks), one light session in race week, plus the daily shoulder_maintenance routine. Band external rotation is in every upper session. || SWIMMING (athlete, rev 2.2): Total Immersion, easy, as general aerobic + upper-body work. MONDAY (active recovery after the long run) and FRIDAY (before Upper B; push complements the swim's pull). Wednesday avoided (Upper A is pull - same muscles), Tue/Thu avoided (already double days). Ramp-in: 1/week Fridays W2-5, 2/week from W6, 30 -> 45-50 min by Build, 30-min technique-only in the peak run weeks (W22, 23, 25). NO swim on the Mondays before AeT tests (identical inputs), on gate-day+1 Mondays (W11, W13), on Oracle+2 (W19), or in the Oracle and Tuscany race weeks (W18, W29). W11/W13 Friday swims move to Saturday with Upper B. Not counted in run volume or the ramp guard; swim_minutes counted in weekly hours. SHOULDER STACK (left shoulder history + 2 upper sessions + poles from January): stop at the first front/top pinch; swimming is dropped before Upper A. Swim sessions use the v1.7 cross_session type (master_schema_v6); strength_sessions counts exclude them. || POLES (decision 9/30: race with poles from ~mi 27): pole-specific upper work (straight-arm pulldown, triceps, double-pole band pulls) from W14. || DOUBLE-DAY RULES (carried): run first, 4+ h gap; lower body PM after the Tuesday climbing session and the Thursday session is valid; no lower-body strength day-of or day-before the Sunday long run; Gate D and Oracle weeks protected. Age-50 recovery criteria (carried): drop a session (Upper B first, then reduce Lower A load - never skip Lower B tendon work, the heel isometrics or the shoulder work) when 2 of: resting HR +7 bpm, sleep < 6 h twice in 3 days, soreness beyond 48 h. NO NSAIDs around loading sessions. || COMPLIANCE (ask #5, carried): every P1 item is a named session or routine; Sunday check in every week; two P1 misses in a week = message the coach. Home gym: barbell, squat rack, pull-up bar, cable row, bands, box (weighted vest optional for ME step-ups; dumbbells work).
